lastUpdated().details: Consumers compare `block.timestamp - lastUpdated()` against a max age to      reject stale prices. Live-read oracles (e.g. ones reading from a canonical      LST contract each call) may return `block.timestamp` since freshness is      sourced upstream rather than via push updates.

getEthValue(uint256).notice: ETH value (wei) of `lstAmount` LST tokens at current price.

getLstValue(uint256).notice: Inverse: how many LST tokens correspond to `ethAmount` wei.

lastUpdated().notice: Unix timestamp of the most recent price update the oracle relied on.
